Container.Name: joplin-mcp
Container.Overview: Joplin MCP Server (Streamable HTTP). Bridge to a Joplin Desktop Web Clipper API on another host. Point MCP clients at http://[IP]:[PORT:8000]/mcp.

Config.Name: JOPLIN_READ_ONLY
Config.Description: true disables every write tool (create/update/delete/tag/import), leaving only search_notes, get_note, list_tags, get_note_tags. Set this while the endpoint is reachable without authentication.

Config.Name: JOPLIN_IMPORT_ROOT
Config.Description: Directory import_markdown may read from. Leave EMPTY to remove the tool. Unconfined it reads any file in the container, including /proc/self/environ, which contains JOPLIN_TOKEN.

Config.Name: JOPLIN_ALLOW_PERMANENT_DELETE
Config.Description: true allows delete_note(permanent=true), which bypasses the Joplin trash and cannot be undone. Leave false; normal deletes still work and stay recoverable.
